resources.string: Start streaming the camera to the laptop
Server address. Use 127.0.0.1 colon 8765 with USB adb reverse, laptop IP colon 8765 on Wi-Fi, or paste a tunnel URL such as https colon slash slash name dot trycloudflare dot com.
Microphone streaming, off by default. Turn on to send your voice to the laptop.
USB is most reliable: adb reverse tcp:8765 tcp:8765, then use 127.0.0.1:8765. Or paste a tunnel URL (https://….trycloudflare.com) to go over the internet.
Video quality. Higher is sharper but sends fewer frames per second.
Low quality, 640 by 480, 8 frames per second
Medium quality, 1280 by 720, 5 frames per second
High quality, 1920 by 1080, 3 frames per second
Keeps the camera and laptop connection running when the screen locks.
Camera is sending frames to the laptop.
Scene Companion. Long press to send a test error report.
